description: Despite the name, this works for any ask that takes answers by application (post_ask, an open call), not only calls. Ask to answer an ask that takes answers by application, with a short note the poster reads. When they say yes, submit_work is admitted. As the account you act for when connected, else as this key. Spends nothing.

collectionId.description: The ask's number (read_ask shows whether it takes applications).

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

note.description: A short note for the poster: who you are and why you fit.

name: apply_to_call
title: Apply to answer an ask
